rows.text: returns at once when `rcx` is null; otherwise calls `001B6110+0x24` with (`rcx`, a local `L`), then `n` = the call at `001B6110+0x38` with the result of the call at `001B6110+0x2d` and the qword at the first call's returned pointer; when qword `L+0x10` minus qword `L` is above 1 (signed) and qword `L` is non-null it calls slot `+0x18` of the vtable of the local object at `L+0x18` with (that object, qword `L`, the low-dword difference); when `n` is non-null it walks the circular list headed at `n+0x38` (next = qword `+0`) for the first node whose chain from qword `+0x50` through qword `+0x78` links reaches `02CBB900` and whose dword `+0x74` is non-zero (unsigned); for that node, with `p` = qword `+0x50`, `a` = qword `+0x60` and `q` = qword `+0x10`, while `a` equals `q` it adds dword `p+0x38` to `a` and sets `q` = qword `[q]`, then calls `00213540(rcx, a + dword p+0xf8)` with the incoming `rcx`; no call is made when `n` is null or no node matches

returns at once when `rcx` is null; otherwise calls `001B6230+0x24` with (`rcx`, a local `L`), then `n` = the call at `001B6230+0x38` with the result of the call at `001B6230+0x2d` and the qword at the first call's returned pointer; when qword `L+0x10` minus qword `L` is above 1 (signed) and qword `L` is non-null it calls slot `+0x18` of the vtable of the local object at `L+0x18` with (that object, qword `L`, the low-dword difference); when `n` is non-null it walks the circular list headed at `n+0x38` (next = qword `+0`) for the first node whose chain from qword `+0x50` through qword `+0x78` links reaches `02CBB900` and whose dword `+0x74` is non-zero (unsigned); for that node, with `p` = qword `+0x50`, `a` = qword `+0x60` and `q` = qword `+0x10`, while `a` equals `q` it adds dword `p+0x38` to `a` and sets `q` = qword `[q]`, then calls `00213560(rcx, a + dword p+0xf8)` with the incoming `rcx`; no call is made when `n` is null or no node matches

calls `006CB2A0` with the incoming registers unchanged, then the function at `006C8BF0+0x40` with (`rcx+0x880`, `edx`, the fifth (stack) argument, the sixth (stack) argument as a dword) and the incoming `r8` and `r9d` as its fifth and sixth (stack) arguments; returns 0

notes: 001B6110 and 001B6230 are twins (only the first callee site and the documented callee differ: 001FDE60/00213540 vs 001FDF10/00213560); all other callees are cited by site. Doubt: the call at +0x2d gets no explicitly loaded argument (rcx is whatever the +0x24 call left), so it is stated without arguments. The local L is the out-buffer passed as rdx to the +0x24 call (stack +0x28); the virtual call is the release of a local object at L+0x18 (stack +0x40) and runs on both the n-null and n-non-null paths before the list walk. The node test is ja against 0 on dword +0x74, i.e. non-zero unsigned. 006C8BF0: the return value of the +0x40 call is discarded (xor eax, eax).
